findings.symptom: Material mismatch in infill across central skirt.
findings.evidence: In y:88..94, x:45..55, the swoosh infill was filled with burgundy red tunic color (#592d2b / #34181e) cutting diagonally across the chainmail skirt, whereas F05 and F07 have steel chainmail texture (#413f4c / #1f1c24).
findings.cause: Tunic color flood applied across chainmail region during material reconstruction.
findings.safeSuggestion: Recolor the infill at y:88..94, x:45..55 to match the steel chainmail greys of F05/F07.

findings.symptom: Wooden weapon haft and severed wooden block/stub persist resting horizontally across the right shoulder and neck.
findings.evidence: While the iron blade was erased, the horizontal wooden shaft resting across the trapezius remains, terminating in a brown rectangular wooden block at x:83..92, y:15..20 and a vertical black peg at x:70, y:14..18. The right arm does not represent a clenched fist rising naturally between F01 (hand at hip) and F03 (hoist with raised fist), but a horizontal beam resting on the neck.
findings.cause: Developer truncated only the metallic axe blade and colored the end of the shaft brown, failing to remove the weapon haft and failing to reconstruct a natural anatomical arm/glove transition.
findings.impact: Direct persistence of layers-off violation and severe kinematic break. When independent rear axe equipment is attached, the horizontal shaft will duplicate/collide.
findings.safeSuggestion: Requires genuine anatomical re-authoring of the right arm/glove in F02 transitioning from low rest (F01) to raised hoist (F03), completely removing the horizontal shaft and shoulder block.
